desc: a guest playing together takes Mario's seat (the host says yes) and presses Start: Mario's Start menu (the big one) opens on the guest's screen and the host's world stands still while it's up ('Paused by' the guest on the host's screen); a second Start closes it and the world goes on

log_must: co-op: player 2 \(Mario\) opened the Start menu: the world stands still
co-op: player 2's Start menu \(Mario's\) closed: the world goes on
